title: Efficacy Study of Prucalopride to Treat Chronic Intestinal Pseudo-Obstruction (CIP)
brief_summary: This study was designed to investigate the clinical safety, tolerability and efficacy of prucalopride in improving the symptoms associated with chronic intestinal pseudo-obstruction (CIP) in subjects with CIP. The study hypothesis was that prucalopride at doses up to 4 mg is safe, well tolerated, efficacious and improves the symptoms associated with CIP.
